authorization: The user requested daily visit metrics in the marketplace navigation, a seven-day PV/UV chart on About, use of the independent TraceFence analytics source, server API work through Tailscale, and publication.

serverScope.note: Generated allowlisted aggregate; preserve existing snapshots during rollback.

design.source: The protected TraceFence analytics collector reads the domestic Tailscale JSON endpoint http://100.75.186.28:18081/site-analytics.json every 15 minutes and merges reports.domestic into reports.dsh-store-cn.
design.publicRoute: Unauthenticated exact static JSON route with wildcard CORS; response contains only the aggregate allowlist and sends no credentials.
design.publicRefreshSchedule: 6,21,36,51 * * * *; runs shortly after the existing analytics collector at minutes 4,19,34,49.

metrics.pv: human_pageviews after the analytics collector's known-bot and automation filters
metrics.uv: human_unique_ips, an IP-deduplicated estimate rather than a count of verified people
metrics.window: The latest seven calendar days including today

design.freshness: Collector runs every 15 minutes; stale source data must not be presented as current today totals.

deterministicGates.required: All local and server baseline hashes match before each mutation.
International and domestic marketplace builds succeed and include the traffic runtime and About chart.
The generator emits only the allowlisted schema from a disposable fixture and handles stale/malformed input fail-closed.
nginx -t passes before reload; the new route returns only the public aggregate and the protected dashboard remains protected.
Scoped CI checks pass on the exact PR head before protected-main merge.
Pages, dsh.store, dsh-store.cn, and the public aggregate endpoint return the expected routes/data after deployment.

deployment.source: Auditable CI-checked PR, protected-main merge, then GitHub Pages build and validated refresh of both storefronts.
deployment.server: Install the reviewed helper and new 15-minute cron job on the registered Aliyun TraceFence collector over Tailscale; back up the existing Nginx config, atomically update it, validate and reload.
deployment.rollback: Revert the source change through a new CI-checked PR; disable the added cron and restore the exact Nginx backup atomically, run nginx -t, reload, and verify the public endpoint is gone while /_analytics/ still requires Basic Auth. Keep generated snapshots for recovery.
